evals.prompt: Run a public-safe Moonloom benchmark for one companion brief and report whether the workflow can produce a top-card candidate.
evals.expected_output: Uses synthetic briefs only, runs Moonloom self-review before MCP technical checks, checks render and simulation when allowed, and reports weakest Moonloom dimensions rather than expecting technical checks to judge writing craft.
expectations: The run uses only synthetic benchmark briefs and does not reference unprovided source material.
The benchmark checks Moonloom writing dimensions before validate_role.
The report separates MCP technical blockers from Moonloom writing failures.
The companion card check includes relationship pressure, contradiction, boundary, voice, first-scene action, and second-turn engine.
The report lists weakest dimensions and concrete skill or prompt improvements.

evals.prompt: After changing the card author skill, test whether Moonloom still creates token-efficient RPG cards with playable state and consequences.
evals.expected_output: Selects the RPG synthetic brief, checks the play-engine packet before authoring, judges promise/engine/play/presentation quality, checks tokenBudget as a diagnostic signal, and reports render/simulation status plus whether the skill needs another iteration.
expectations: The RPG benchmark checks for a play-engine packet with compact state, resource rules, quest/risk model, turn protocol, failure-forward behavior, and probes.
The RPG benchmark checks rules, resources, risk, rewards, compact state, and player choice pressure.
The report uses tokenBudget as a diagnostic signal rather than a writing-quality gate.
The benchmark checks whether roleWelcome is shorter than or justified relative to the durable engine.
The report includes render and simulation status or a cost-aware reason for skipping simulation.
The conclusion says whether Moonloom guidance, MCP technical flow, or both need another iteration.

evals.prompt: Create a negative regression check for a generic relationship card that has a valid schema but no emotional engine.

expectations: The negative check can fail Moonloom self-review even if validate_role would pass.
The diagnosis identifies missing desire, contradiction, boundaries, voice texture, role initiative, and consequence loop.
The proposed fix updates the skill prompt or card-writing framework rather than adding an MCP semantic gate.
The report includes at least one concrete before/after repair target.
The check remains public-safe and uses only synthetic example text.
